caseNameFull: Edward Field, Plaintiff in Error, v. Pardon G. Seabury Et Al.
summary: This, like the preceding case, was brought up, by writ of error, from the Circuit Court of the United States for the dis- . trict of California. It was argued in connection with the preceding case.
headnotes: The decision in the preceding case of Field v. Seabury, again affirmed.

opinions.author: 'Wayke
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice ’WAYKE

delivered the opinion of the court..

*334 This case was like the preceding, and they were argued together.

Eor the reasons given in tire first of them, the court directs the reversal of the judgment in the court below, in this case.
